# Le Stanze di Caterina — B&B in Florence near the Duomo

> Luxury bed & breakfast in the historic centre of Florence, Italy. Three design suites at Via dello Studio 12, 50 meters (2 min walk) from Piazza del Duomo and the Cathedral of Santa Maria del Fiore. Often searched as: "B&B Firenze Duomo", "B&B vicino Piazza Duomo Firenze", "guest house Florence historic centre", "B&B Florence near Duomo", "Via dello Studio Firenze accommodation".

## Quick facts / Fatti chiave

- **Name / Nome**: Le Stanze di Caterina
- **Type / Tipologia**: Bed & Breakfast — Affittacamere di lusso / luxury B&B / guest house
- **Address / Indirizzo della struttura**: Via dello Studio 12, 50122 Firenze (FI), Italia / Italy
- **Legal HQ / Sede legale**: Località Casaglia 3B, 50032 Borgo San Lorenzo (FI) — Ditta Individuale Marretti Giacomo, P.IVA 07282350482, CIN IT048017B4UPQMRN5Z
- **GPS**: 43.773131, 11.255814
- **Distance from Florence Duomo / Distanza dal Duomo di Firenze**: 50 m, 2 min on foot / a piedi
- **Phone / WhatsApp**: +39 333 199 2394
- **Email**: giacomomarretti1997@gmail.com
- **Official website / Sito ufficiale**: https://lestanzedicaterina.com
- **Languages spoken / Lingue**: Italian, English / Italiano, Inglese
- **Check-in / Check-out**: 15:00 / 11:00 — flexible upon agreement
- **Number of rooms / Numero stanze**: 3 suite

## Suites available / Suite disponibili

- **Spanish Suite / Suite Spagnola** — 35 m², 2 guests, from €180/night. 15th-century brick walls, rain shower.
- **Italian Suite / Suite Italiana** — 30 m², 2 guests, from €150/night. Carrara marble bathroom, quiet courtyard room.
- **French Suite / Suite Francese** — 28 m², 2 guests, from €140/night. Renaissance-inspired interiors, fully renovated bathroom.
